notes:
Summary: Qualified via CTO intro (2025-09-12). Heavy interest in low-latency chat + reranking for personalized ad experiences. After intro email and two follow-ups, contact went quiet — likely internal budget freeze and no clear champion. Detailed timeline below.

Timeline / activity: 
- 2025-09-12: Lead created after referral from partner; intro email sent (AE: Maya).
- 2025-09-15: Discovery call (30m) w/ CTO (R. Hernandez) + infra lead; primary ask: sub-100ms tail latency for chat, vector search with daily indexing, SSO + audit logs. Fireflies id ff_2025-09-15_7890.
- 2025-09-18: Sent tailored pricing + perf deck (drive://redwood/pricing/edgeverge-pricing-v1.pdf). Noted they preferred hosted for quick POC but VPC for production.
- 2025-09-25: SE deep-dive w/ Liam — discussed batching, KV cache, and routing policies; SE shared perf microbenchmarks for 2k TPS burst.
- 2025-10-01: Security review kickoff: requested SOC2 report and KMS integration doc. Provided security FAQ (drive://redwood/security/edgeverge-security-answers.docx).
- 2025-10-10: Last meaningful interaction — CTO replied "We're paused on new vendor POCs until budget cycle closes." Stated they'd circle back after Q4 planning.
- 2025-10-20 to 2025-11-04: 3 follow-up emails (intro note, technical brief, pricing revision). No replies. Gmail thread thread-1652a4b3c-edgeverge-intro.

Use-case & requirements (as stated): 
- Workload: high-concurrency real-time chat for personalized ad experiences; online reranking for click prediction; vector search for large catalog.
- Latency/throughput: p95 < 120ms for short-chat flows; sustained throughput ~500 rps, burst to 2k rps.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high — want predictable unit costs; open to reserved capacity if ARR justified.
- Models: prefer open weights (Llama-family, mix with quantized variants) but will consider vetted closed models for specific tasks.
- Routing/fallback: require regional routing (na primary) and automatic fallback to smaller model variant under load.

Security/compliance notes: 
- Must integrate with Azure AD via SAML; retention controls and audit logs required.
- Data residency: US-only for initial rollouts.
- KMS/HSM for key management mandated by Infosec.

Why stalled: 
- Primary: internal budget freeze (CTO comment 2025-10-10).
- Secondary: no internal product owner assigned; infra team not empowered to push POC.
- Tertiary: security wants vendor SOC2 + encryption details before approving POC — we provided docs but no follow-up on them.

Outreach notes & suggested plays: 
- Short-term: SE (Liam) to send 1-pager mapping our KMS/SAML answers to their compliance checklist (due 2025-11-12).
- Medium-term: Offer a 6-week hosted POC credit with clear rollback and data retention limits to de-risk procurement.
- If no response: mark as "stalled — re-engage Q1 2026" and route to inbound nurture.

Quotes / snippets: 
- CTO: "We like your runtime benchmarks, but procurement is frozen until headcount/budget decisions next quarter."
- Infra lead: "Need clear SSO/KMS flow diagrams and a list of retained logs before we can sign off."

Risks: 
- Likely lost to budget/time; competitor risk if they pick a one-click hosted provider that avoids VPC complexity.

Next admin: AE follow-up call attempt week of 2025-11-10; if no response, update stage->discovery/stalled and set re-engagement cadence.
